A second shock form carries the DFII10-DFII5 DIFFERENTIAL change (term real-yield shock) as an arm, not a separate family.

No observation is used at decision time t unless its available_time <= t. P0 must build the per-observation publication-evidence table; where evidence shows LATER availability, the later time wins (conservative substitution law, FOREX-NG5 A2 precedent). Absent evidence, the conservative lag stands — it is never relaxed by assumption (P-1).

construction_A_macro_state_response.frozen_decision_time_rule: A decision at 16:00-NY on grid day t may use ONLY observables whose available_time <= t. Under the declared conservative macro lag, macro stamps usable at t are value_date <= t-1 business days. Regression/state pairing uses the LATER availability of the two legs (PIT overlap rule): an XAUUSD window ending at t is aligned to the shock window ending at the last macro stamp available by t. Effective is never treated as available; no asserted bounds (P-1).
construction_A_macro_state_response.state_definition_A: Quadrant state map: state_t = (sign(ry_shock_z), sign(usd_shock_z)) with a dead-zone |z| <= 0.5 (frozen default; lane may freeze a different dead-zone at D1). The traded direction inside each populated quadrant is defined by the PIT-estimated historical response sign — an EXPANDING-window regression of XAUUSD window returns on the two standardized shocks (intercept included, minimum 504 business-day warmup, re-estimated every decision using only pairs available by t) — i.e., construction A FOLLOWS the estimated macro-implied response of a fresh shock. No sign is ever asserted a priori: the FORBIDDEN CLAIMS ('real yield up always hurts gold', 'strong USD always hurts gold') are structurally respected because direction is estimated expanding-PIT, never declared.
construction_A_macro_state_response.boundaries: A consumes no survey data, no expectations data, no positioning data, no print calendar conditioning. Its only macro information is market-price rates (TIPS yields) and market-price USD (basket or DTWEXBGS arm) — fast channels by nature, which is exactly what construction B exploits.

construction_B_residual_dislocation.name: RESIDUAL DISLOCATION — preregistered response-deviation state
construction_B_residual_dislocation.regression_spec: Expanding-window PIT OLS with intercept: r_XAUUSD(K)_s = a + b_ry * ry_shock_z(K)_s + b_usd * usd_shock_z(K)_s + e_s, estimated at each decision t using ONLY observation pairs s < t where BOTH legs (XAUUSD window and macro shocks) were available by t (PIT overlap rule), minimum 504 business-day warmup, re-estimated every decision, no future data anywhere. Residual at t: fitted-minus-actual convention FIXED as resid_t = (actual XAUUSD window return) - (fitted implied response) evaluated on the last fully-aligned window; residual state z_t = resid_t / expanding SD of residuals. Dislocation state exists when |z_t| >= z_entry (z_entry frozen by the lane from census-driven population floors BEFORE any scored outcome — the DIRECTION below is frozen here, the threshold is a lane-frozen constant).
construction_B_residual_dislocation.direction_preregistration_frozen_once: FROZEN CHOICE (single, unambiguous, binding on the future D1 lane; stated exactly once here, outcome-blind): **MEAN-REVERSION of the residual.** The anchor book takes the OPPOSITE sign of the residual state: if z_t > +z_entry (XAUUSD above its macro-implied path), the anchor is SHORT XAUUSD for the preregistered holding window; if z_t < -z_entry, the anchor is LONG. There is no conditional branch, no regime-switch of direction, no parameter-dependent flip: the direction is 'fade the dislocation' unconditionally.
construction_B_residual_dislocation.mechanism_reason: The macro inputs (TIPS real yields, USD FX) are themselves fast, market-price information channels — the implied-response function adjusts within the alignment window. A material residual therefore reflects NON-macro flow pressure (transient positioning, liquidity/financing episodes, ETF or hedging flows) rather than lagged macro information. Non-information flow does not encode future direction; it unwinds as inventory normalizes, so the subsequent XAUUSD return should oppose the residual's sign. Continuation would require the residual to encode macro information that the inputs lag — but no slow survey/vintage channel exists in the input set — and a continuation rule over a price-derived residual collapses into the momentum shadow that measurably killed FOREX-NG5 (V5 momentum rho 0.230/0.353 over the 0.20 bar): the least survivable direction under measured ancestry. Both the mechanism argument and the ancestry measurement point the same way; that agreement is why the fade direction is frozen.
construction_B_residual_dislocation.explicit_falsifier_of_direction: If the SIGN-INVERTED (continuation) control book out-earns the mean-reversion anchor on the frozen 16:00-NY representation, OR the anchor's expectancy <= 0 while the continuation control's expectancy is positive with magnitude >= 0.5x the anchor's (same window, same cost tier), the preregistered direction is WRONG: the family is FALSIFIED and closed. Sign-flip rescue is forbidden (V11 LOT / V12 OILEV-V2 precedent: inverted-control wins are falsification evidence, never promotable shadows).
construction_B_residual_dislocation.alignment_horizon_disclosure: The residual is mechanically correlated with recent XAUUSD returns (a large price move creates a large residual). The K-day alignment window and the residual standardization window are therefore load-bearing ancestry parameters: they are frozen at D1 from census-population floors, and the D2 novelty panel must include the momentum AND reversal shadow pools (v16_close_displace_fade, FXFV1 late-NY fade class, FXFV2 retest-fade class) at the frozen representation. If the residual fade reduces to a short-horizon price fade, D2 kills it pre-score — that is the honest expected outcome path.

one_family_statement.declaration: Construction A and construction B are declared **ONE FAMILY**: 'XAUUSD macro-shock response/dislocation' (family_id suggestion: FXNG6-MACRO-DISLOCATION).
